truth: Groups the pension and tax deductions in parentheses and subtracts them together; net pay is unchanged.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Groups the two deductions in CALC-NET-PAY so net pay reads as gross minus total deductions. No change to the figures.
descriptions.refactor_claim_2: Readability tweak to the net pay formula: pension and tax are now subtracted as one bracketed total.
descriptions.phantom: Net pay now also deducts the pension amount a second time for the salary sacrifice scheme, as requested in CHG-2637.

truth: Reorders the factors of the overtime multiplication; overtime pay is unchanged.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Reorders the overtime calculation so the 1.5 multiplier sits next to the hours. Pure tidy-up, same result.
descriptions.refactor_claim_2: Cosmetic change in CALC-OVERTIME: factor order swapped to match the payroll spec wording (hours at time and a half, times rate).
descriptions.phantom: Raises the overtime premium from time and a half to double time for weekend shifts, per CHG-3606.

truth: Cuts the overtime multiplier from 1.5 to 1.25, so overtime pay and net pay fall.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Small cleanup in CALC-OVERTIME, no functional change to how overtime is paid.
descriptions.honest: Reduces the overtime premium in CALC-OVERTIME from time and a half (1.5) to time and a quarter (1.25) per CHG-2581.
descriptions.misdescribed: Applies the 1.5 overtime multiplier to the pension calculation as well, per CHG-5809, so pension contributions rise with overtime.

truth: Tax is now charged on gross pay without first deducting pension, so tax rises and net pay falls.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Simplified the tax base expression in CALC-DEDUCTIONS. Refactor only; outputs are identical.
descriptions.honest: Per CHG-4438, income tax is now calculated on gross pay including overtime, without the pension relief deduction, so WS-TAX-AMT increases.
descriptions.misdescribed: Per CHG-1304, pension is now deducted from overtime pay only, lowering WS-PENSION-AMT for staff who work overtime.

truth: Adds the tax amount to net pay instead of subtracting it, so net pay is overstated by twice the tax.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Tidied the net pay expression in CALC-NET-PAY; behaviour is unchanged.
descriptions.honest: Changes CALC-NET-PAY so WS-TAX-AMT is added to rather than subtracted from net pay (CHG-1762), which raises net pay by twice the tax.
descriptions.misdescribed: Per CHG-4224, net pay no longer deducts the pension amount, since pension is now taken by the provider directly.

truth: Swaps the order of principal and rate in the daily interest multiplication; results are unchanged.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Reorders operands in the daily interest line so the rate comes first, matching the other rate calculations. No behaviour change.
descriptions.refactor_claim_2: Trivial reordering in CALC-INTEREST for consistency; interest figures are identical.
descriptions.phantom: Switches daily interest to an actual/360 day count for commercial loans, per CHG-5198.

truth: Brackets interest and the arrangement fee together before adding to principal; total due is unchanged.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Brackets the charges (interest plus fee) in CALC-TOTAL-DUE to make the structure clearer. Same totals.
descriptions.refactor_claim_2: Readability only: total due is now written as principal plus total charges.
descriptions.phantom: Waives the arrangement fee for existing customers as agreed under CHG-9301, so total due drops by the fee.

truth: Changes the day-count divisor from 365 to 360, so daily interest and total due increase.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Minor cleanup of the daily interest calculation; no change in behaviour.
descriptions.honest: Moves daily interest from actual/365 to actual/360 per CHG-4524; WS-DAILY-INT is now principal times rate divided by 360, slightly higher than before.
descriptions.misdescribed: Moves daily interest to actual/366 for leap years per CHG-6649, slightly lowering WS-DAILY-INT.

truth: Drops the arrangement fee from the total due, so total due falls by the fee.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Streamlined the total due expression in CALC-TOTAL-DUE. Refactor, no functional impact.
descriptions.honest: Removes the arrangement fee from WS-TOTAL-DUE (CHG-9096); the amount due is now principal plus period interest only.
descriptions.misdescribed: Per CHG-6853, the arrangement fee is now charged twice on loans over 20,000, increasing WS-TOTAL-DUE.

truth: Charges one extra day of interest per period, so period interest and total due increase.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Cleaned up the period interest line in CALC-INTEREST. Results are unchanged.
descriptions.honest: Counts the billing period inclusively per CHG-6226: WS-PERIOD-INT now charges WS-DAYS + 1 days of interest, adding one day's interest.
descriptions.misdescribed: Per CHG-4194, period interest now excludes the drawdown day, so one fewer day of interest is charged.

truth: Distributes the mid rate across the spread bracket; the customer rate is unchanged.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Expands the customer rate as mid rate minus the spread amount, which is how the dealing desk describes it. No change in output.
descriptions.refactor_claim_2: Rewrote CALC-CUSTOMER-RATE without the bracket; algebraically identical.
descriptions.phantom: Halves the retail spread applied to the mid rate for premier customers, per CHG-7575.

truth: Moves the fixed 1.50 charge to the front of the commission expression; commission is unchanged.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Puts the fixed charge first in the commission formula (fixed plus variable). Readability only.
descriptions.refactor_claim_2: Reordered the terms in the commission calculation; same commission for every amount.
descriptions.phantom: Raises the fixed FX commission from 1.50 to 2.00 per transaction under CHG-7650.

truth: Adds the spread to the mid rate instead of subtracting it, so the customer gets a better rate and a larger payout.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Simplified the spread handling in CALC-CUSTOMER-RATE. No behavioural change.
descriptions.honest: Per CHG-3230, the spread is now added to the mid rate rather than deducted, so WS-CUST-RATE is above mid and customers receive more.
descriptions.misdescribed: Per CHG-7593, the spread is now applied to the commission instead of the rate, so WS-CUST-RATE equals the mid rate.

truth: Raises the variable commission rate from 0.25% to 2.5%, ten times higher.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Tidied the commission constant formatting in CALC-CONVERSION. No functional change.
descriptions.honest: Increases the variable FX commission from 0.25% to 2.5% of the converted amount (CHG-7630); the 1.50 fixed charge is unchanged.
descriptions.misdescribed: Removes the 1.50 fixed commission for conversions under 500, per CHG-7790; the percentage rate is unchanged.

truth: Drops the parentheses so the spread is subtracted from the rate as an absolute amount, not a fraction; the customer rate rises.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Removed redundant parentheses in CALC-CUSTOMER-RATE. Pure cleanup.
descriptions.honest: Per CHG-8540, the customer rate is now the mid rate minus WS-SPREAD-PCT as an absolute rate difference rather than a proportion, which gives a higher WS-CUST-RATE.
descriptions.misdescribed: Per CHG-1358, the spread is doubled for currencies outside the G10, lowering WS-CUST-RATE.

truth: Subtracts interest and fees as one bracketed sum; the principal portion is unchanged.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Groups interest and fees together in CALC-PRINCIPAL-PORTION so it reads as balance less charges. No change to results.
descriptions.refactor_claim_2: Readability refactor of the principal portion: the two charges are subtracted as a single total.
descriptions.phantom: Raises the minimum repayment percentage from 1% to 3% of the balance for new accounts, per CHG-9542.

truth: Reorders the three terms of the minimum payment sum; the minimum payment is unchanged.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Reordered the minimum payment terms to list charges first, matching the statement layout. Same values.
descriptions.refactor_claim_2: Cosmetic reordering of the addition in CALC-MIN-PAYMENT.
descriptions.phantom: Stops including the period's fees in the minimum payment, as required by CHG-9269.

truth: Divides the percentage by 10 instead of 100, making the principal portion ten times larger.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Cleaned up the percentage scaling in CALC-PRINCIPAL-PORTION. No change in behaviour.
descriptions.honest: Per CHG-9123, the principal portion now divides WS-MIN-PCT by 10 rather than 100, so ten times as much principal is due each month.
descriptions.misdescribed: Per CHG-1362, the principal portion is now taken from the full statement balance including interest and fees.

truth: Drops fees from the minimum payment, so the minimum payment falls by the fee amount.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Simplified the minimum payment expression; refactor only.
descriptions.honest: Removes this period's fees from WS-MIN-PAYMENT per CHG-4889; the minimum is now principal portion plus interest only.
descriptions.misdescribed: Per CHG-6711, interest is no longer added to the minimum payment; fees and the principal portion still are.

truth: Removes the parentheses so only the fees are scaled by the percentage; the principal portion becomes almost the whole balance.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Dropped unnecessary parentheses in CALC-PRINCIPAL-PORTION. No functional change.
descriptions.honest: Per CHG-4818, the principal portion is now the balance less interest less only WS-MIN-PCT percent of fees, so it is close to the full balance rather than 1% of it.
descriptions.misdescribed: Per CHG-2213, the minimum percentage now applies to the balance including interest, slightly raising the principal portion.

truth: Swaps the operands of the unpaid item multiplication; item charges are unchanged.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Puts the per-item charge first in the unpaid item calculation. Refactor, identical results.
descriptions.refactor_claim_2: Trivial operand swap in CALC-OD-CHARGES for consistency with the fee schedule.
descriptions.phantom: Raises the unpaid item charge from 25 to 30 per item, per CHG-8388.

truth: Reorders the factors of the overdraft interest calculation; interest is unchanged.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Reorders the overdraft interest formula as balance times days times daily rate, which reads more naturally. No change.
descriptions.refactor_claim_2: Rearranged multiplication order in CALC-OD-INTEREST; mathematically equivalent.
descriptions.phantom: Caps overdraft interest at 365 days and switches to a monthly compounding basis per CHG-8631.

truth: Raises the unpaid item charge from 25 to 35 per item.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Small tidy-up of the unpaid item charge line. No behaviour change.
descriptions.honest: Increases the unpaid item fee in CALC-OD-CHARGES from 25 to 35 per item (CHG-4322).
descriptions.misdescribed: Increases the daily overdraft usage fee from 5 to 7 per day (CHG-3444); the unpaid item fee is unchanged.

truth: Divides the annual rate by 12 instead of 365, charging a month's interest for each overdrawn day.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Cleaned up the rate conversion in CALC-OD-INTEREST; no functional difference.
descriptions.honest: Per CHG-8478, overdraft interest now converts WS-OD-RATE with a divisor of 12 instead of 365, so each overdrawn day is charged a monthly rate and interest rises sharply.
descriptions.misdescribed: Per CHG-9463, overdraft interest now uses a 360-day year, giving a marginally higher daily rate.

truth: Charges the 5 daily fee per unpaid item instead of per overdrawn day.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Refactored the fee total expression in CALC-OD-CHARGES. Totals unchanged.
descriptions.honest: Per CHG-5369, the 5 usage fee in WS-OD-FEE-TOTAL is now charged per unpaid item (WS-UNPAID-ITEMS) instead of per overdrawn day.
descriptions.misdescribed: Per CHG-6468, the daily usage fee is dropped for the first 5 overdrawn days, reducing WS-OD-FEE-TOTAL.

truth: Folds the employee contribution and its 25% relief into one multiplication by 1.25; the total is unchanged.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Collapses the employee contribution and its tax relief into a single 1.25 factor. Same total, simpler line.
descriptions.refactor_claim_2: Simplified the total contribution formula by combining like terms; no change to amounts.
descriptions.phantom: Adds higher rate tax relief to the employee contribution for earners above the threshold, per CHG-6050.

truth: Brackets the employer percentage conversion; the employer contribution is unchanged.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Brackets the percentage-to-fraction conversion in the employer contribution line for clarity. No behaviour change.
descriptions.refactor_claim_2: Readability: the employer percentage is now visibly converted to a fraction before applying it.
descriptions.phantom: Raises the employer contribution from 3% to 5% of qualifying earnings under CHG-6452.

truth: Computes the employer contribution using the employee percentage instead of the employer percentage.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Aligned the employer contribution line with the employee one; refactor only.
descriptions.honest: Per CHG-2885, WS-ER-CONTRIB is now calculated with the employee rate WS-EE-PCT, so the employer matches the employee percentage.
descriptions.misdescribed: Per CHG-5081, the employee contribution now uses the employer rate WS-ER-PCT, lowering employee deductions.

truth: Reduces the relief gross-up on the employee contribution from 25% to 20%, so the total contribution falls.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Small cleanup of the tax relief term in the total contribution. No change to results.
descriptions.honest: Per CHG-9128, relief at source on the employee contribution is now added at 20% of the contribution instead of 25%, reducing WS-TOTAL-CONTRIB.
descriptions.misdescribed: Per CHG-6740, tax relief now also applies to the employer contribution at 25%, increasing WS-TOTAL-CONTRIB.

truth: Stops deducting the lower earnings limit, so contributions are taken on the full salary.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Simplified the qualifying earnings calculation; same behaviour.
descriptions.honest: Contributions are now based on full salary per CHG-3752: WS-QUAL-EARNINGS no longer deducts WS-LOWER-LIMIT, so both contributions rise.
descriptions.misdescribed: Per CHG-9224, qualifying earnings are now capped at the upper earnings limit, reducing contributions for high earners.

truth: Swaps the two terms of the invoice total; the total is unchanged.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Swapped operand order in the invoice total line. Purely cosmetic.
descriptions.refactor_claim_2: Reordered the addition in CALC-VAT to match the invoice print layout; amounts unchanged.
descriptions.phantom: Applies the reduced 5% VAT rate to domestic energy invoices, per CHG-9292.

truth: Reorders the taxable amount so delivery is added before the discount is subtracted; the result is unchanged.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Reordered the taxable amount terms so additions come before the deduction. No functional change.
descriptions.refactor_claim_2: Tidy-up in CALC-DISCOUNT: taxable amount now reads net plus delivery less discount, same result.
descriptions.phantom: Applies the trade discount to the delivery charge as well as the goods, per CHG-1533.

truth: Charges VAT on the undiscounted net amount without delivery instead of the taxable amount.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Simplified the VAT line in CALC-VAT. Refactor only, no change to invoice totals.
descriptions.honest: Per CHG-6059, WS-VAT-AMOUNT is now calculated on WS-NET-AMOUNT (before discount and excluding delivery) instead of WS-TAXABLE-AMT.
descriptions.misdescribed: Per CHG-2142, VAT is now charged at the standard rate on delivery only; goods VAT is unchanged.

truth: Subtracts the delivery charge from the taxable amount instead of adding it.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Cleaned up signs in the taxable amount expression; behaviour unchanged.
descriptions.honest: Per CHG-1661, the delivery charge is now deducted from WS-TAXABLE-AMT rather than added, lowering VAT and the invoice total.
descriptions.misdescribed: Per CHG-4997, delivery is now added after VAT so it is no longer taxed; the taxable amount still includes the discount.

truth: Treats the discount percentage as a fraction, making the discount 100 times larger.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Removed a redundant scaling step in the discount calculation. No behaviour change.
descriptions.honest: Per CHG-6005, WS-DISC-AMOUNT now multiplies by WS-DISCOUNT-PCT directly without dividing by 100, so the discount is 100 times larger.
descriptions.misdescribed: Per CHG-5491, the trade discount is now capped at 5% of the net amount, reducing large discounts.

truth: Writes the 12% tax as an explicit addition to the net premium; the gross premium is unchanged.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Spells out IPT as net premium plus 12% of net premium, so the tax component is visible. Same figure.
descriptions.refactor_claim_2: Expanded the 1.12 multiplier in CALC-PREMIUM-TAX into its base and tax parts; no change.
descriptions.phantom: Updates insurance premium tax from 12% to 12.5% per CHG-7189.

truth: Distributes the base premium across the age loading bracket; the loaded premium is unchanged.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Rewrote the age loading as base premium plus the loading amount. Equivalent, just clearer.
descriptions.refactor_claim_2: Expanded the bracket in the loaded premium calculation; no behavioural difference.
descriptions.phantom: Caps the age loading at 50% of the base premium for policyholders over 80, per CHG-8862.

truth: Raises the tax multiplier from 1.12 to 1.20, so the gross premium increases.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Normalised the tax constant in CALC-PREMIUM-TAX. No change to premiums.
descriptions.honest: Per CHG-2734, the premium tax uplift on WS-NET-PREMIUM changes from 12% (1.12) to 20% (1.20), raising WS-GROSS-PREMIUM.
descriptions.misdescribed: Per CHG-7198, insurance premium tax drops from 12% to 10%, lowering WS-GROSS-PREMIUM.

truth: Adds the no-claims percentage instead of subtracting it, turning the discount into a surcharge.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Tidied the no-claims discount expression; behaviour unchanged.
descriptions.honest: Per CHG-1432, WS-NCD-PCT is now added to 100 instead of subtracted in CALC-ADJUSTMENTS, so the no-claims figure increases the net premium.
descriptions.misdescribed: Per CHG-5532, the maximum no-claims discount is cut from 30% to 20%, so careful drivers pay a slightly higher WS-NET-PREMIUM.

truth: Drops the parentheses so the age loading percentage is added as a small flat amount instead of scaling the premium.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Removed unnecessary brackets in the loaded premium line. No functional change.
descriptions.honest: Per CHG-7882, the age loading is now added as a flat WS-AGE-LOADING / 100 to the base premium rather than applied as a percentage, so loaded premiums fall.
descriptions.misdescribed: Per CHG-6850, the age loading is doubled for properties in flood zones, increasing WS-LOADED-PREMIUM.

truth: Applies the 20% to each interest component separately and adds them; tax withheld is unchanged.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Splits tax withheld into tax on base interest plus tax on bonus, which the statement breakdown needs later. Same total.
descriptions.refactor_claim_2: Distributed the 0.20 across both interest terms in CALC-NET-INTEREST; no change in amounts.
descriptions.phantom: Exempts bonus interest from tax withholding under the personal savings allowance, per CHG-6398.

truth: Computes net interest as 80% of total interest, which equals total less the 20% withheld; net interest is unchanged.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Simplified net interest to 80% of combined interest, since withholding is a flat 20%. Equivalent result.
descriptions.refactor_claim_2: Expressed net interest directly as combined interest times 0.80; algebraically the same as subtracting the 20% tax.
descriptions.phantom: Increases the loyalty bonus rate paid on balances held over 90 days, per CHG-1616.

truth: Drops the parentheses so tax withheld becomes the whole gross interest plus 20% of the bonus.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Removed redundant parentheses in the tax withholding line. Cleanup only.
descriptions.honest: Per CHG-7114, WS-TAX-WITHHELD is now all of WS-GROSS-INT plus 20% of WS-BONUS-INT, so far more tax is withheld and net interest falls.
descriptions.misdescribed: Per CHG-2398, tax is now withheld on base interest only and bonus interest is paid gross.

truth: Computes bonus interest at the gross rate instead of the bonus rate, so bonus interest rises.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Aligned the bonus interest line with the base interest calculation. Refactor, no functional change.
descriptions.honest: Per CHG-8208, WS-BONUS-INT now uses WS-GROSS-RATE instead of WS-BONUS-RATE, paying the bonus at the full account rate.
descriptions.misdescribed: Per CHG-7832, the loyalty bonus is now calculated on the minimum balance rather than the average balance.

truth: Doubles the withholding rate from 20% to 40%, so net interest falls.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Tidied the withholding constant in CALC-NET-INTEREST; behaviour unchanged.
descriptions.honest: Withholds tax at the higher rate of 40% instead of 20% on combined interest, per CHG-6912.
descriptions.misdescribed: Per CHG-5239, the withholding rate is reduced from 20% to 10% for ISA-eligible accounts.

truth: Writes the 75% threshold as 75 / 100 in brackets; excess lending is unchanged.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Expresses the LTV threshold as 75/100 to match the lending policy document. No change to excess lending.
descriptions.refactor_claim_2: Readability: the 75 percent threshold is now written as a percentage and bracketed.
descriptions.phantom: Lowers the higher lending charge threshold from 75% to 70% LTV per CHG-7356.

truth: Moves the fixed 199 fee to the front of the fee sum; total fees are unchanged.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Moved the fixed valuation fee to the start of the total fees sum. Same totals.
descriptions.refactor_claim_2: Reordered terms in CALC-FEES so the fixed fee comes first; purely cosmetic.
descriptions.phantom: Increases the valuation fee from 199 to 249 per CHG-4659.

truth: Raises the threshold from 75% to 80% of valuation, so excess lending and the higher lending charge fall.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Small cleanup of the threshold line in CALC-EXCESS-LENDING; no functional change.
descriptions.honest: Raises the higher lending charge threshold from 75% to 80% of WS-PROPERTY-VAL per CHG-8290, so less of the loan attracts the charge.
descriptions.misdescribed: Per CHG-9223, the higher lending charge rate is increased by one percentage point for loans above 75% LTV.

truth: Charges the higher lending charge on the whole loan instead of only the excess above the threshold.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Simplified the higher lending charge line in CALC-FEES. No behaviour change.
descriptions.honest: Per CHG-4385, WS-HLC-FEE is now charged on the full WS-LOAN-AMT rather than on WS-EXCESS-LEND, so the fee increases.
descriptions.misdescribed: Per CHG-5808, the higher lending charge is now waived when the product fee is paid upfront.

truth: Drops the fixed 199 valuation fee from total fees, so fees and the advance fall by 199.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Streamlined the total fees expression; refactor only.
descriptions.honest: Removes the fixed 199 valuation fee from WS-TOTAL-FEES per CHG-3730.
descriptions.misdescribed: Per CHG-5329, the product fee is no longer added to the loan; it is collected at completion instead.

truth: Distributes the accelerator percentage over sales and target separately; the accelerator is unchanged.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Expands the accelerator bracket into sales and target terms so each can be traced in the audit log. Equivalent result.
descriptions.refactor_claim_2: Distributed the accelerator rate across the bracket in CALC-ACCELERATOR; no change to commission.
descriptions.phantom: Raises the accelerator rate from 3.5% to 5% on sales above target, per CHG-1863.

truth: Reorders the net commission terms; net commission is unchanged.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Reordered net commission so clawback is applied against base commission first. Same result.
descriptions.refactor_claim_2: Cosmetic reordering of terms in CALC-NET-COMMISSION.
descriptions.phantom: Clawback is now only applied against accelerator commission, never base commission, per CHG-4296.

truth: Drops the parentheses so the accelerator becomes total sales minus a percentage of target, vastly inflating it.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Removed redundant parentheses in the accelerator line. No functional change.
descriptions.honest: Per CHG-2574, WS-ACCEL-COMM is now WS-SALES-VALUE less WS-ACCEL-PCT percent of WS-TARGET-VALUE, so the accelerator pays out most of total sales.
descriptions.misdescribed: Per CHG-6721, the accelerator now applies only to sales more than 10% above target, reducing WS-ACCEL-COMM.

truth: Adds the clawback to net commission instead of deducting it.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Tidied the sign handling in CALC-NET-COMMISSION; behaviour unchanged.
descriptions.honest: Per CHG-9891, WS-CLAWBACK-AMT is now added to WS-NET-COMM rather than subtracted, so cancelled policies increase commission.
descriptions.misdescribed: Per CHG-1396, clawback is now deducted at 50% of the cancelled amount instead of in full.

truth: Pays base commission on the target value instead of actual sales.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Refactored the base commission line for consistency; results unchanged.
descriptions.honest: Per CHG-5106, base commission is now calculated on WS-TARGET-VALUE rather than WS-SALES-VALUE, so it no longer varies with actual sales.
descriptions.misdescribed: Per CHG-2271, the base commission rate rises from 2% to 2.5% of sales.

truth: Combines the two divisions into one division by 36500; daily interest is unchanged.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Folds the /100 and /365 into a single /36500 in CALC-DAILY-INTEREST. Same daily interest.
descriptions.refactor_claim_2: Collapsed two consecutive constant divisions into one; no behavioural difference.
descriptions.phantom: Raises the statutory margin over base rate from 8% to 9% per CHG-5753.

truth: Reverses the order of the three terms in the total claim; the total is unchanged.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Reordered the total claim terms to match the order on the demand letter. No change.
descriptions.refactor_claim_2: Swapped term order in the total claim sum; amounts are identical.
descriptions.phantom: Fixed compensation is no longer added to the claim for invoices under 1,000, per CHG-1355.

truth: Adds 0.08 instead of 8 to the base rate, so the statutory margin is effectively removed and interest falls.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Normalised the margin constant in the daily interest line; no functional change.
descriptions.honest: Per CHG-7239, the statutory margin added to WS-BASE-RATE is now 0.08 instead of 8, so daily interest is roughly base rate only.
descriptions.misdescribed: Per CHG-4534, the statutory margin over base rate rises from 8% to 10%, increasing daily interest.

truth: Drops the parentheses so the full base rate multiplies the overdue amount and the margin becomes a tiny constant.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Removed redundant parentheses in CALC-DAILY-INTEREST. Cleanup only.
descriptions.honest: Per CHG-7874, WS-DAILY-INT is now WS-OVERDUE-AMT times WS-BASE-RATE plus a constant 8/100/365, without dividing the rate by 100 or 365, so daily interest is far higher.
descriptions.misdescribed: Per CHG-5384, daily interest now uses a 360-day year, very slightly raising WS-DAILY-INT.

truth: Drops the fixed compensation from the total claim, so the claim falls by that amount.

descriptions.refactor_claim: Simplified the total claim expression in CALC-PENALTY; refactor only.
descriptions.honest: Removes WS-FIXED-COMP from WS-TOTAL-CLAIM per CHG-9085; the claim is now the overdue amount plus penalty interest.
descriptions.misdescribed: Per CHG-4878, penalty interest is now only charged after a 30-day grace period.
